dmso4: DMSO Safety: This protocol has you smell DMSO for anxiety and brain fog. It's a solvent that goes straight through your skin and lungs into your blood, and the thing to watch is what it carries in with it, whether that's something in the bottle or something on you. So you should use 99.9% Pharmaceutical Grade DMSO, ideally in a glass bottle, since it can leach chemicals out of some plastics. It's sold on Amazon and other sites (I've never had a bad batch). Before using it, wash any lotions or other products off your hands and nose. Your lungs count too, so if you're a smoker, breathe in only a little at a time, since it can pull the tar from your lungs into your blood, and stop if you feel weak right afterwards, which is the first sign of that. My full DMSO reference goes into the other ways to use it and what else to watch for.
elec4: Electrolytes: This protocol has you eating a lot more potassium than most people get, so consult a doctor first if you have kidney disease or heart conditions, or take a blood pressure drug that holds on to potassium. Those are the ACE inhibitors and ARBs (names ending in -pril or -sartan), and with them or with weak kidneys, potassium can build up in your blood.
ethno4: Ethnobotanicals: The plant medicines in this protocol are iboga (an African root bark) and psilocybin mushrooms. Both are illegal in many jurisdictions and carry risks, and iboga's are the serious ones, since it can be dangerous for your heart and nervous system. So never combine Iboga with most medications (especially heart & psych meds), and if you take any, check it against my full iboga guide here first (the iboga microdosing protocol is here).
iso4: Behavioral Warning (The Isolation Trap): This protocol has you starve your brain of "Phasic" Dopamine, the bursts you get from excitement, novelty and the chase. The easiest way to do that is to hole up alone, but do not isolate completely, because total isolation raises your stress hormone, cortisol, which makes your brain over-react to glutamate (its main excitatory signal, explained below), and that locks the armor in place whether or not you've ever had an addiction. Since we're social animals, what you need instead is the "Oxytocinergic Anchoring" of healthy relationships, meaning company that calms you with the bonding hormone oxytocin, and the rule below says which kind.

agm4: Agmatine Warning (The Voltage Governor): Agmatine is an optional add-on in this protocol, and although it's sold as a supplement, it isn't a basic nutrient like magnesium or a membrane nutrient like phosphatidylcholine, but a neuromodulator that acts on several of the brain's signaling systems at once (NMDA/glutamate signaling, imidazoline/alpha-2 adrenergic tone, nitric-oxide pathways, and the reward and tolerance you get from opioids). That means it can clash with any drug that works on the same systems, so if you take agmatine, go by the precautions below, which name those drugs.
htp4: Uridine & 5-HTP Warning for Psychedelic Users: These two supplements are in this protocol for repair, so don't use them as "trip enhancers." In practice they can quickly change how strongly psychedelics hit you, so don't count on your usual dose acting the way it used to. 5-HTP is also what your body makes serotonin out of, so taking it on top of anything else that raises serotonin is how people end up with serotonin syndrome, an overload that can be deadly if untreated (see the 5-HTP section). So never take it with any of these: antidepressants (SSRIs, SNRIs, MAOIs), the antibiotic linezolid, lithium, the opioids tramadol, methadone and fentanyl, the cough suppressant DXM, MDMA, or the supplements St. John's wort, SAM-e and L-tryptophan. Rule: psychedelics act on serotonin too, so do not take 5-HTP on the same day as a psychedelic trip, and do not use it anywhere near ayahuasca/harmalas or iboga, iboga microdoses included. That's because ayahuasca's harmalas inhibit MAO-A, the enzyme that breaks serotonin down, which amplifies the serotonin load, while ibogaine and noribogaine (what your body turns ibogaine into) interact with serotonin transport themselves, on top of the serious cardiac and neurological risk iboga already carries.
uri4: Uridine (the UMP in this protocol) doesn't raise serotonin, so its caution is a different one, and it comes from experience like Scott's below, since I don't have studies on it: within a day of starting it, psychedelics can hit harder, visuals included. So do not take UMP on the same day as a psychedelic trip, and on your first trip after starting it, assume your old psychedelic dose may now be too high and take less. It may also make your dreams more vivid and your cravings weaker, which are the benefits you're hoping for.
